common.unavailable: That item is no longer available.
start.welcome:
Hi {name}! I keep your tasks, events, workouts, and files.
Pick a section below.
help.text: Use the menu below. ➕ creates tasks/events, ⚙️ adjusts settings, /remember <text> stores a fact, /facts lists them, /language changes the language, /cancel aborts an in-progress step.
settings.tz_prompt: Send the IANA timezone, e.g. Europe/Berlin. /cancel aborts.
settings.digest_prompt: Send the digest time as HH:MM (24-hour). /cancel aborts.
settings.tz_invalid: {value!r} is not a valid IANA timezone. Try again.
draft.help:
Just describe the task in natural language, e.g.
"Tomorrow at 18:30 remind me to call Alex".

You can also send the structured line format:
title: Buy groceries
date: 2026-09-21
time: 18:30
due: 2026-09-21 19:00
priority: high
kind: event
remind: -30, 0
description: milk, bread
`remind:` is optional — minutes before the start time (0 = at the
start, negative = after). Only `title` is required. /cancel aborts.
workouts.log_prompt:
Send: name, minutes, effort (1-10) — the last two are optional.
Example: Running, 30, 7
/cancel aborts.
workouts.schedule_prompt:
Send: name, YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM
Example: Running, 2026-09-23 18:00
/cancel aborts.
workouts.scheduled:
📅 Scheduled: {title} at {when} ({tz}).
You'll get a reminder at the start time.
files.empty: No files yet. Send me a document to store it.
files.saved: 📄 Saved {filename}. I'm indexing it in the background — check 📁 My files for the status.
ask.prompt: Send me a question as a normal message and I will answer it.
facts.usage:
Usage: /remember <what to remember>, e.g.
/remember I prefer morning workouts

I will ask you to confirm before storing it as a fact.
facts.proposed:
📝 Proposed fact: {value}
Confirm it to remember long-term:
facts.empty: You have no stored facts. Use /remember to add one.
facts.stored:
✅ Remembered: {value}
I'll use confirmed facts in chat.
facts.unavailable: That fact is no longer available.
digest.title: Good morning, {name}! Your day on {date}:
digest.workouts: Workouts: {week} this week, current streak {streak} day(s).
motivation.overdue: You have overdue items — even a ten-minute push today keeps the momentum alive.
motivation.workout: Workout on the way — a bit of rest now is fuel for later.
motivation.streak: {streak}-day streak. Consistency compounds; keep it alive.
motivation.empty: Your schedule is clear today — a good time to plan one small win.
motivation.default: One thing done is better than ten planned.
errors.generic: Sorry, something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.ai_unavailable: Sorry, I can't reach my language model right now. Please try again in a bit.
miniapp.status_auth: Authentication failed — reopen the app from the bot.
miniapp.status_open: Open this page inside Telegram to continue.
miniapp.files_empty: No files uploaded yet — send a document to the bot.
miniapp.facts_add: Add a fact (stays proposed until confirmed)
miniapp.facts_value_ph: Tell the assistant something to remember
